executiveSummary.headline: Strong AI Visibility, With Opportunities to Improve Digital Accuracy and Control
executiveSummary.lead: Spice Island Beach Resort is well positioned in the AI travel searches monitored by Dealality, ranking first among its certified competitive group. This provides a strong foundation as more travelers turn to AI when researching hotels and destinations.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: These metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not booking conversion or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Hotel Information Accuracy
themes.what: The official website lists a Michelin Star for Oliver Restaurant that does not match Michelin’s published One MICHELIN Key recognition. Selected travel sites also show different suite sizes and offer terms than the official site.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests and advisors expect accurate luxury details. Conflicts create uncertainty and booking friction.

themes.title: Digital Presence and Information Control
themes.what: An independently operated booking site uses a domain similar to the official website, and a staging hostname appeared in limited AI citations. Some automated requests to the official site were blocked in research testing.
themes.whyItMatters: Confirm which sites represent the resort and whether intended search and AI systems can reach official content before changing access settings.

themes.title: Selective Commercial Opportunities
themes.what: There is no guest-facing official page for intimate executive retreats or exclusive gatherings—only a post-stay conference feedback form.
themes.whyItMatters: Clearer presentation could attract appropriately sized inquiries if management wants that demand. Pursue only if commercially attractive.

priorities.desiredOutcome: Accurate Michelin recognition on official channels
Consistent facts for guests and travel partners

priorities.action: Investigate independent sites and automated access
priorities.desiredOutcome: Clearer ownership and verified technical access
Qualified demand aligned with resort positioning

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Greater confidence that Spice Island’s digital presence accurately communicates the offer, with clear actions the marketing team can implement and verify.
executiveSummary.closing: Spice Island’s AI visibility is already a competitive strength. The immediate opportunity is to protect that position by correcting inaccurate information, improving consistency across digital channels, and ensuring the resort’s official content is readily accessible. These targeted actions establish a practical foundation for continued monitoring and improvement.

payload.actionPlanIntro: Findings above are not repeated in full. Each action states the recommendation, owner, timing, completion criteria, and agency steps with evidence links.

actions.headline: Correct Inaccurate Michelin Award Information on the Official Website
actions.priorityWhy: Public, specific claim that conflicts with Michelin’s published hotel recognition.
actions.whatWeFound: Dining-page structured data lists a Michelin Star for Oliver; Michelin’s hotel listing shows One MICHELIN Key for the resort.
actions.whyItMatters: Unsupported Star language risks reputation if checked against Michelin and can be repeated by AI systems. Correction protects accuracy; it does not guarantee more mentions or revenue.
recommendedSteps: Hotel confirms Key year/status and that Oliver has no restaurant Star.
Agency removes unsupported Star from Oliver Restaurant structured data.
If approved, add One MICHELIN Key only at hotel-level awards metadata.
Replace brand placeholder “Unmanaged” with the hotel-approved brand string.
Verify and archive before/after evidence.
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Within 2–3 weeks of hotel Key confirmation

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Hotel confirmation of Key year/status and no restaurant Star is on file.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Dining-page structured data updated (Star removed; Key added only if approved; brand placeholder fixed).
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Live view-source / rich-results check confirms no restaurant Star and Key language matches approval.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Only if hotel documents that Michelin recognition already matches live structured data—file that rationale; do not leave an unsupported Star in place.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Confirm Key year/status and no restaurant Star before adding Key metadata.

supportingEvidence.label: Michelin Guide hotel listing — One MICHELIN Key

changesOrInvestigation: Inspect JSON-LD / schema.org Restaurant awards on the dining page (machine-readable facts for search/AI).
Remove “Michelin Star 2025” from the Restaurant node.
If approved, place One MICHELIN Key on Hotel-level awards only—not as a Star substitute.
Update brand.name from “Unmanaged” to hotel-approved brand string.
technicalDetails.verificationMethod: View-source and Google Rich Results / schema validator; archive before/after.
technicalDetails.notes: Do not place Key language on the Restaurant node as a Star substitute.

actions.headline: Align Suite Sizes, Offer Rules, and Public Titles Across Trusted Listings
actions.priorityWhy: Named public pages disagree on concrete guest-facing facts.
actions.whatWeFound: Official Seagrape size and honeymoon minimum differ from Pure Grenada and/or the independent booking host at research time.
actions.whyItMatters: Guests comparing channels should see the same facts. Corrections improve consistency; they do not automatically lift AI rankings or bookings.
recommendedSteps: Hotel signs a one-page source-of-truth sheet.
Agency diffs Pure Grenada and authorized partners against the sheet.
Submit correction requests only for confirmed fields.
Log before/after notes per URL; skip tone-only OTA rewrites without a factual conflict.
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Source-of-truth within 2 weeks; partner corrections within 30–45 days of sign-off
actions.timeframeNote: Partner response times vary; deadlines require hotel agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Signed source-of-truth sheet compared to named live URLs; mismatches logged.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Correction tickets/emails filed for each confirmed mismatch (or written decline where partner status blocks outreach).
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Named URLs match the signed sheet, or open tickets show last follow-up date.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if hotel documents that the official sheet already matches all named pages—or that a host is unauthorized and must not be corrected pending AVA-SIB-003.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Sign the source-of-truth sheet before external correction requests.

supportingEvidence.label: Official rooms page — Seagrape 945 sq ft

changesOrInvestigation: Draft source-of-truth: suite sizes; honeymoon minimum; public titles; phones/emails.
Diff Pure Grenada and independent host against signed sheet.
Submit field-level correction tickets; archive screenshots.

evidence.label: Pure Grenada
evidence.note: Different Seagrape size at research date

evidence.label: Independent booking host
evidence.note: Different suite size; honeymoon FAQ differed

technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Compare live pages to signed sheet; retain ticket IDs and screenshots.
dependencies: Partner authorization clarity for the independent host (AVA-SIB-003).
technicalDetails.notes: Treat the independent booking host carefully until authorization is confirmed.

actions.headline: Clarify the BookResorts Relationship, Staging Website, and Automated Access Context
actions.priorityWhy: Authorization unknown; hostname similarity warrants a hotel decision.
actions.whatWeFound: BookResorts positions itself as an independent agency on a similar domain; limited AI citations also referenced staging. Authorization unknown.
actions.whyItMatters: Similar domains can be treated as hotel-affiliated. Confirm control before brand/fact alignment or other steps. Resolving ownership does not by itself change AI peer rankings.
recommendedSteps: Hotel confirms whether BookResorts is authorized.
If yes: align facts/branding to the source-of-truth sheet.
If no: hotel decides commercial/legal next steps with advisors.
Confirm staging hostname control; restrict if unintended.
Document the decision for agency and monthly tracking.
actions.supportingParties: Digital marketing agency; legal/commercial advisors if needed
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Hotel decision within 2 weeks; partner alignment within 30–45 days if authorized
actions.timeframeNote: Legal timelines, if any, are hotel-determined.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Written hotel answer on BookResorts authorization and staging control is on file.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: If authorized: alignment tickets filed. If not: documented next-step memo (commercial/legal) is filed.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: If authorized: partner page facts match the signed sheet (or open tickets logged). If staging restricted: public check confirms intended state.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid only with a written hotel decision that the current partner/staging posture is intentional and needs no change—rationale on file.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Authorization is UNKNOWN until the hotel answers. Do not allege improper conduct.

changesOrInvestigation: Confirm DNS/ownership and commercial relationship for spiceisland-beachresort.com.
Identify staging hostname control and access posture.
If authorized: sync facts from source-of-truth; review branding.
If not authorized: hotel advisors determine outreach or enforcement path.
technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Written hotel decision memo; staging URL check; partner tickets if applicable.
technicalDetails.notes: About control and consistency—not citation volume alone.

actions.headline: Review Website Access for Search Engines and AI Systems
actions.priorityWhy: robots.txt and security rules should agree; no proof of global outage.
actions.whatWeFound: Automated research clients often saw Cloudflare 403s; browsers still retrieved pages. robots.txt allows major AI crawlers.
actions.whyItMatters: Unintended crawler blocks can push automated systems toward secondary sources. A CDN review clarifies risk; it does not guarantee higher AI visibility.
recommendedSteps: Agency opens a CDN/security ticket describing the research 403 pattern.
Partner compares WAF/bot rules with robots.txt allowances.
Hotel approves any production allowlist change before it is applied.
Retest homepage and key pages; file results.
actions.supportingParties: CDN / security partner; hotel approves production rule changes
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Review ticket within 2 weeks; any approved rule change within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: No production CDN change without hotel approval.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: CDN/security review note comparing WAF/bot rules to robots.txt is on file.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: If a rule change is needed: hotel-approved change request submitted to the CDN partner.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Agreed test clients retest homepage/key pages; before/after status codes documented.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if the partner documents that intended crawlers are already allowed and research-environment 403s do not warrant production change—rationale on file.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Approve any production WAF/bot allowlist change. Do not assume global blockage from research-environment 403s alone.

supportingEvidence.label: Research-environment automated access probe
supportingEvidence.note: 403 pattern observed; not a public page

changesOrInvestigation: Reproduce automated GET of homepage from non-browser client; record status codes.
Compare Cloudflare WAF/bot rules with robots.txt AI crawler list.
If conflict confirmed and hotel approves, adjust allowlists for intended crawlers only.
Retest homepage, rooms, dining, and specials URLs.
technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Partner ticket with before/after status codes from agreed test clients.
dependencies: Hotel approval before production rule changes.
technicalDetails.notes: Research-environment signal to investigate—not proof of global blockage.

actions.headline: Decide Whether to Publish a Selective Meetings and Executive-Retreat Page
actions.priorityWhy: Commercial go/no-go—not a verified accuracy defect.
actions.whatWeFound: No guest-facing meetings product page; conference-review form only. Leadership-discussed capacities imply intimate, selective fit.
actions.whyItMatters: A capacity-honest hotel page can attract qualified small-group demand if wanted. Publishing does not guarantee leads or revenue.
recommendedSteps: Hotel holds go/no-go meeting.
If no-go: document decision; no page required.
If go: lock signed capacity/policy sheet; reconcile wedding guest-max messaging before publish.
Agency publishes one restrained page with clear fit and inquiry path.
actions.supportingParties: Digital marketing agency / website developer (build only if approved)
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Go/no-go within 30 days; if approved, page live within 60–90 days
actions.timeframeNote: No build work without commercial confirmation.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Written commercial go/no-go is on file (with capacity constraints acknowledged if go).
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: If go: page draft submitted for hotel approval against the signed capacity sheet.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: If go: live page matches signed capacities/policies. If no-go: decision memo filed and action closed.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid when leadership documents a no-go—no page is required; rationale on file.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Do not launch without management confirmation. Reconcile wedding guest-max with private-event capacity messaging before publish.

changesOrInvestigation: Confirm sitemap still lacks a meetings product URL.
If go: draft page structure (audience, capacities, policies, inquiry path).
Do not copy third-party capacities blindly.
CMS publish and QA against signed sheet.
technicalDetails.verificationMethod: If go: live URL QA against signed capacity sheet. If no-go: decision memo only.
technicalDetails.notes: Optional commercial opportunity—not a verified accuracy defect.

methodology.scope: Combines certified AI Demand Performance measurement with a bounded public-website and third-party review. No new paid AI measurement was run for this document.

responsibilities: Hotel GM / commercial leadership — decisions, awards, source-of-truth, meetings go/no-go.
Digital marketing agency / website developer — schema, listings, page production if approved.
CDN / security partner — automated access review against robots.txt.
Dealality — measurement context and evidence packaging; optional later monthly tracking.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions can later be tracked in the monthly AI Demand Performance Review. Completing an action does not, by itself, prove AI or revenue change.
